page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top, centred-left. Page number at top right. One marginal note in the right margin beside the second paragraph. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: do fuisse, quam nunc est, & à multis annis fuit. Nam praetorium imperium, & jurisdictionem pene omnem soli Ripperdai & Houverdai, aut qui his successere, dudum nunc tenent, &, quem volunt, Consulem, id est, Redgerum oppidanis dant. Iudices illorum vix umbram rei, cuius nomen ferunt, retinent; nec vocare quenquam, nec prehendere, nec coercere, aut in vincula dare, non causas, non crimina cognoscere, nec de his, nec de illis sententias ferre possunt. De Dammona plus satis.

Vici & eorsi numerus & cultus.Reliqua per omnem agrum vici tenent, & in his fanis insignes plus minus CLX; quorum non pauci ea magnitudine & cultu, ut oppidula videri queant. Cujusmodi sunt Visleta ad Lavicam, & Northorma in Longowoldis: Winsumum ad Hunesi flexum una[?] infra Groningam milliari, Bedumum, Utbusa, Middelsthemum, Warsumum in Hunesgonis: Lopperfhemum, Berumum, Farmsumum, & quae nominata jam est Farmsumo proxima, unaq; cum eo in ora Amasi[?] posita ad Fivela exitum, Delssyla[?], amplis nunc munitionibus & firmis, velut urbs, cincta, portu quoq; celebris, in Fivelingis: Winscota, & quondam floreus, nunc fluctibus Dullarti attrita, penèq; hausta, Midwolda, cum fano quatuor turribus late conspicuo, in praefectura veteri: ut de Reiderwolda, ijdem in partibus funditus delata,

page.notes: Trailing hook-shaped marks after several words (quam, nunc, imperium, tenent, etc.) are read as commas; their exact form is uncertain. "una" at the line end of "flexum" is partly cut off. "Amasi" has a small mark before it that may be an ornament or letter. "Delssyla" is uncertain: the scan shows a ligature that could be "Delffyla" or "Delfsyla". Note text "eorsi" is faint. The page ends mid-sentence; "qua" at the bottom right is the catchword.
